row.notes: Computes mip deficit for a streamed texture: wanted = density*scale*p3 against the per-mip size table at tex+0xd8 (mip bounds tex+0x35..+0x39), picks mip index, raises pending-mip count, uses ctx+0x1f0/0x200 and ctx flags 0x21c. Log strings TEXTURE_STREAM_ADD_COMMANDS, "[Priority %3.3f] Density [%3.3f] Deficit [%3.3f] ... Mips %d to %d", "FAILED for %s Required %llu, Available Memory %d, Available Temp Memory". Caller Game_TextureStreaming_AdjustQualityFactor. Addon: texture streaming debug/quality.
